title: Noise-Injection Sandbagging Detector as a Reusable Tool

original_idea.body: # Noise-Injection Sandbagging Detector as a Reusable Tool. Package weight-noise injection into a CLI producing a capability-vs-noise curve flagging the non-monotonic bump; validate on a password-locked model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Turnkey sandbagging detector enables external auditing of open-weight releases.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Weight-noise sweep + benchmark eval packaged as CLI; guided, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused tool + validation on a password-locked model; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Community auditing infrastructure for open weights, no internal access; labs deprioritize.

low_compute.reasoning: Multiple full-benchmark inference passes per noise level on a local model.

novelty.reasoning: Noise-injection detection already published; packaging adds engineering not new findings.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Core detection method published; this is mainly tooling around it.
